standard-dialogue.npc: Hello, I've just finished composing my latest poem. Would you like to hear it?

steps.npc: Excellent! The humans an aficionado! Make yourself comfortable and I'll begin...
Twinkle, twinkle little egg Wouldn't you like to grow some legs?  And run around, on grass so green arguing with the milk and cream.
T'was brillig and the slithey toathes Did gyre and gimbol in the wabe All mimsy were the borrowgroves And the mome raths outgrabe.

steps.text: Sometimes this conversation will be followed by:

steps.speaker: Cow
steps.text: That's not even your poem, you idiotic, animated ball of wool!

steps.npc: How now foolish cow? Do you read poetry, instead of pulling a plow?

steps.speaker: Cow
steps.text: I'm not talking to you any more, you're nasty.

steps.npc: Oh no! Cow's not talking to me!
Do I look like I care?
I wish I was a cow My life would be so simple I could lie around just eating grass And wonder if I was a pimple.

steps.text: Sometimes this conversation will be followed by:

steps.npc: Well I thought it was funny.
How goes it, blade of grass? I'm glad you're not any thinner You should invite your friends around So I can have my dinner!
Huh, the cow's right. You humans have absolutely no understanding of art!

using-nuff-s-certificate-on-an-unsheared.text: You show the certificate to the sheep.

using-nuff-s-certificate-on-an-unsheared.player: Do you know what these strange marks mean?

using-nuff-s-certificate-on-an-unsheared.npc: The humans found some symbols And doesn't know what they meanSo now it's cross-examining meAnd spoiling my routine!

sheared-sheep.npc: You give me a hair-cut and then expect me to talk to you? I think not!
